title: Vampire Vape Attraction Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Surrender to the alluring pull of Vampire Vape’s Attraction e-liquid, a captivating fusion of luscious red berries, rich dark fruits, and a stimulating menthol kick. This enticing blend offers a perfect medley of fruity notes, with the tangy sweetness of raspberries and strawberries harmonising beautifully with the depth of blackcurrants and blueberries. The enchanting fruit ensemble is elevated by a refreshing menthol breeze, lending a revitalising edge to this well-rounded vape experience. With its magnetic charm, Attraction beckons you to indulge in its irresistible combination of flavours, promising to become a firm favourite in your DIY e-liquid collection. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
